edits.old: case when payment_behavior_risk>0 then 'Payment Issues' when activity_decline_risk>0 then 'Engagement Decline' when lifecycle_transition_risk>0 then 'Lifecycle Transition' when revenue_at_risk_score>0 then 'High Value at Risk' when support_engagement_risk>0 then 'Support Issues' when email_engagement_risk>0 then 'Communication Breakdown' else 'Standard Monitoring' end as primary_risk_factor
edits.new: CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk >= 3 THEN 'Payment Issues' WHEN activity_decline_risk >= 2 AND platform_abandonment_risk >= 1 THEN 'Engagement Decline' WHEN lifecycle_transition_risk >= 2 THEN 'Lifecycle Transition' WHEN revenue_at_risk_score >= 3 THEN 'High Value at Risk' WHEN support_engagement_risk >= 2 THEN 'Support Issues' WHEN email_engagement_risk >= 1 AND activity_decline_risk >= 1 THEN 'Communication Breakdown' ELSE 'Standard Monitoring' END AS primary_risk_factor

edits.new: CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk >= 3 THEN 'Account Management Call' WHEN activity_decline_risk >= 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 'Executive Outreach' WHEN support_engagement_risk >= 2 THEN 'Customer Success Check-in' WHEN email_engagement_risk >= 2 THEN 'Personalized Email Campaign' WHEN platform_abandonment_risk >= 2 THEN 'Product Adoption Workshop' WHEN lifecycle_transition_risk >= 2 THEN 'Lifecycle-specific Campaign' ELSE 'Automated Monitoring' END AS recommended_intervention
